bonus_paycheck_months_2026.notes: Jon gets 26 biweekly paychecks/year. 2 months will have 3 paychecks instead of 2. Identify by finding months with 3 Fridays that are pay Fridays. Allocate: 50% emergency fund, 30% debt acceleration, 20% sinking funds.
bonus_paycheck_months_2026.identification_method: Given a known pay date, count forward by 14 days to find all 2026 pay dates. Months with 3 = bonus months.
